# Zikel Solutions

Zikel Solutions is a technology company focused on practical, ethical AI adoption, workflow
improvement, and support systems for healthcare teams, educators, and operational teams.

Website: https://www.zikelsolutions.com/
App: https://app.zikelsolutions.com/
Contact: contact@zikelsolutions.com

## What We Do

- AI staff guidance and support systems
- Healthcare workflow tools
- Training intelligence and learning support
- Consultation and implementation support
- Digital workflow improvement for organizations

## Guidance For Agents

- Prefer the page-specific URLs above over guessing service descriptions.
- Use the homepage and service pages for public-facing business information.
- Use the app domain only for product access flows, login, registration, and authenticated actions.
